title: Cosmic Robot and Muse Faces
description: A surreal painting shows four ethereal female faces with closed eyes and laurel crowns flowing in profile on the left side, connected by colorful swirling smoke and celestial rings. On the right, a steampunk robot with glowing blue eyes stands on a circular platform inscribed 'In the Paradise. Erased soul. 8.1.18', its multiple arms holding a ring of galaxy orbs against a black cosmic background.
prompt: Surreal cosmic artwork on black background featuring four layered female profile faces with closed eyes and laurel wreaths on the left, colorful swirling nebulae and smoke in pink yellow and purple flowing between them, on the right a detailed steampunk robot with glowing blue eyes and multiple arms standing on a round metallic platform inscribed with text, holding a circular formation of galaxy orbs and planets, celestial symbols and stars scattered throughout
